Re: Remittance advice for Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057 (your message of 09:32)

I have not forwarded this handover. I need the following before I can pass it on:

1. Approval reference. Your handovers for Northfield Print (FD-0931) and Coleridge Stationers (FD-0932) each carry one. This one does not. Your 30 September note says MD-2026-057 was approved under FD-0929, so please confirm that this remittance advice is covered by FD-0929, or give me the reference that applies to it.

2. Payment handover. Your 30 September note said the Marlow payment handover would follow. I have not received it. The advice says the 5,400.00 GBP was paid on 2 October, so please send the payment handover for MD-2026-057 (or confirm where it is) so that the advice is not issued ahead of the payment it reports.

Once I have both, I will forward the advice to the advices slot for the 2 October 2026 remittance advices run (priority 3) with the values unchanged.
